payload.body_they: Something can look desirable from the outside and still be wrong for the life {{Name}} actually wants. Praise, visibility, or an admired opportunity can make it harder to admit that the terms no longer suit them. The useful question is what the recognition is asking them to trade in time, autonomy, money, creative control, or ordinary quality of life. Recognition matters most when the life attached to it is still one they would choose.
